domain.description: A fictional offline-capable document capture appliance. Routing/understanding only; response prose is not scored.
domain.name: FolioBox

intents.canonical: what is foliobox
intents.fact: FolioBox scans paper documents, runs OCR, stores encrypted local copies, and can export or sync them.

intents.canonical: how do i scan one page
intents.fact: Insert one page face up and press Scan; FolioBox creates one document item.

intents.canonical: how do i scan both sides of a page
intents.fact: Enable Duplex before scanning; FolioBox captures the front and back into one document.

intents.canonical: how do i scan a receipt
intents.fact: Use Receipt mode for narrow paper; it adjusts feed speed and crop detection.

intents.canonical: how do i choose the ocr language
intents.fact: Choose the OCR language per scan or set a default language in Text Recognition settings.

intents.canonical: does text recognition work offline
intents.fact: OCR runs locally and works without internet for installed language packs.

intents.canonical: how do i connect foliobox to wifi
intents.fact: Hold Link for three seconds, open FolioBox Setup on a phone, then select the Wi-Fi network.

intents.canonical: how do i export a scan as pdf
intents.fact: Open the document, choose Export, then select PDF.

intents.canonical: how do i make a searchable pdf
intents.fact: Enable Searchable PDF during export; OCR text is embedded behind the page image.

intents.canonical: are scans encrypted on foliobox
intents.fact: Local documents are encrypted at rest with the device storage key.

intents.canonical: how much can foliobox store
intents.fact: The built-in storage holds about twenty thousand ordinary text pages, depending on image complexity.

intents.canonical: how do i delete a scan from the device
intents.fact: Open the document, choose Delete, and confirm; deleted local items move to Recently Deleted for seven days.

intents.canonical: how do i back up scans to usb
intents.fact: Connect a USB drive and choose Backup to USB; FolioBox writes an encrypted backup archive.

intents.canonical: how does cloud sync work
intents.fact: When enabled and online, completed documents sync to the linked cloud workspace.

intents.canonical: how do i share a document link
intents.fact: Synced documents can create a revocable share link from the app.

intents.canonical: what do i do if paper is jammed
intents.fact: Open the feed door, remove paper in the feed direction, close the door, and retry.

intents.canonical: how do i clean the feed rollers
intents.fact: Power FolioBox off and wipe the feed rollers with a lightly damp lint-free cloth.

intents.canonical: how long does the battery last
intents.fact: A full charge supports about four hundred single-sided page scans under normal conditions.

intents.canonical: how do i restart foliobox without losing scans
intents.fact: Hold Power for five seconds for a soft restart; stored scans and settings are preserved.

intents.canonical: how do i factory reset foliobox
intents.fact: Hold Reset for twelve seconds; local settings and local documents are erased, but already-synced cloud copies remain.

rules.preflight: 20 canonical direct prompts + 5 canonical setup/follow-up exchanges must pass before semantic source freeze.
